author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Everyone hates the daily scrum stand up meeting, why not use AI to automate it. 

As long as everyone answers the 3 standup questions everyday somewhere, in Jira comments or commit messages, the AI agent can pull all the info together and create an AI daily scrum report.

author.name: Zoia Ermolova
author.headline: Business System Analyst I 8+ years experience insurance domain I SaaS I Enterprise Solutions I Digital Transformation  I Agile

comments.text:
MS Teams already has plagin for it:
We actually used this plugin in MS Teams on one of my projects.
Every day, a card popped up in the general channel with the classic 3 standup questions, and everyone had a clear deadline to fill it in.

After that, the Scrum Master reviewed all the cards, checked if there were any blockers or topics that needed discussion, and only brought those items into a live conversation.

It worked well: less meeting fatigue, clear written timeline, and discussions were focused only where needed.
